BespokeWhyChooseSection.description: Tired of template websites that all look the same? A custom website allows you to create a unique online presence with <highlight>eye-catching</highlight> animations, <highlight>bold</highlight> design choices, and a <highlight>distinct</highlight> brand identity.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_ownership_description: Gain <highlight>complete control</highlight> over your digital asset. A bespoke website means you <highlight>own the code</highlight> and have the <highlight>flexibility</highlight> to implement any future vision without limitations.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_performance_description: Custom websites are <highlight>lean</highlight> and <highlight>optimized for speed</highlight>, ensuring a <highlight>fast</highlight> and smooth experience for your visitors, which improves <highlight>SEO</highlight> and <highlight>user engagement</highlight>.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_scalability_description: Your website <highlight>grows</highlight> with your business. Custom solutions are built to be <highlight>easily expandable</highlight>, adding <highlight>new features</highlight> and functionalities as your needs evolve.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_security_description: <highlight>Tailored security measures</highlight> are implemented from the ground up, providing a more <highlight>robust defense</highlight> against <highlight>vulnerabilities</highlight> compared to off-the-shelf platforms.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_support_description: Receive <highlight>personalized support</highlight> and <highlight>maintenance</highlight> for your unique website, ensuring it remains up-to-date, secure, and <highlight>performs optimally</highlight>.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_uniqueness_description: Stand out from the crowd with a website <highlight>custom-designed</highlight> to reflect your brand's <highlight>unique personality</highlight> and values, unlike generic templates.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_ownership_question: Do I <highlight>own</highlight> the code and the website after paying?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_ownership_answer: Yes. Once your project is paid for, you <highlight>own</highlight> the code. It is completely yours. You can host it anywhere, modify it freely, or hand it over to another developer with no restrictions or lock-in.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_hosting_question: Is <highlight>hosting</highlight> included, or do I have to arrange it myself?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_hosting_answer: You can host the site yourself — you own the code, so that is always an option. If you prefer a hands-off experience, we can take care of <highlight>hosting</highlight>, security, updates, and support for you at a slightly higher fee than pure self-hosting.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_updates_question: What if I need <highlight>changes</highlight> or new features after the site is live?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_updates_answer: We are happy to make updates and improvements after launch for very small fees (to be discussed per request). For regular work you can also arrange a lightweight ongoing agreement with us.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_content_editing_question: Can I <highlight>edit</highlight> the content on my website myself?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_content_editing_answer: Yes, if you want. We can provide a <cms>content management system (CMS)</cms> so you can update text, images, and certain sections on your own. Please note that because every site is built to your exact specifications, the <highlight>editing</highlight> experience is not as open-ended as all-in-one template platforms like Squarespace. What you trade for that simplicity is a site that is <highlight>fully customizable</highlight> to your precise requirements.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_design_question: Can you create the <highlight>design</highlight> for my website?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_design_answer: Absolutely. We can deliver a complete custom <highlight>design</highlight>, and we actively encourage you to share reference designs, brand assets, mood boards, or even your own design files. The more direction you give us, the more precisely we can match your vision.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_performance_answer: We generate static pages wherever possible and serve them from modern, high-performance infrastructure located close to your visitors. The result is <highlight>near-instant</highlight> load times, excellent reliability, and strong search engine visibility without any extra effort from you.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_mobile_accessibility_question: Is the site <highlight>mobile-friendly</highlight> and accessible to everyone?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_mobile_accessibility_answer: Mobile support is always included. We follow a <highlight>mobile-first approach</highlight> and ensure the design and interactions scale beautifully from the smallest phones all the way up to ultrawide desktop monitors. We also build accessibility in from the beginning, so the site can be comfortably navigated using screen readers, keyboard controls, and other assistive technologies by people with visual impairments or reduced mobility.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.title: Why a personal website outperforms templates

CommercialProposalAFaq.title: Built for decision-makers
CommercialProposalAFaq.description: Straight answers on ownership, delivery, and what it takes to ship commercial software with CodeHouse.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_ownership_question: Who <highlight>owns</highlight> the software when the project is done?
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_ownership_answer: You do. Once the agreed work is paid for, you <highlight>own the code</highlight> and the product. There is no platform lock-in — you can host it yourself, move vendors, or extend it with another team.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_timeline_question: How long does a typical project <highlight>take</highlight>?
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_timeline_answer: A focused module or MVP often lands in <highlight>weeks to a few months</highlight>. Larger multi-system platforms are phased so you see value early instead of waiting for a big-bang launch. We confirm a realistic timeline after scoping.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_scope_question: Can you handle both <highlight>small tools</highlight> and large systems?
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_scope_answer: Yes. We build everything from a single operational microservice to multi-module platforms (CRM, portals, inventory, dashboards). We size the architecture to your roadmap so you do not overbuy on day one.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_hosting_answer: You can self-host — you own the code. If you prefer a hands-off setup, we can manage <highlight>hosting</highlight>, deployments, monitoring, and updates as an ongoing service.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_maintenance_question: What about <highlight>maintenance</highlight> and new features after launch?
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_maintenance_answer: Post-launch changes are available on request or via a lightweight retainer. Security patches, dependency updates, and feature iterations are planned around your operational priorities — not a rigid SaaS roadmap.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_security_answer: Security is designed in from the start: authentication, authorization, encrypted traffic, least-privilege access, and infrastructure suited to commercial data. We align controls with the sensitivity of your workflows and compliance needs.
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_ip_question: What happens to <highlight>IP</highlight> and third-party licenses?
CommercialProposalAFaq.faq_ip_answer: Custom code delivered for your project is yours. Open-source and third-party components keep their original licenses — we document what is used so your legal and IT teams have a clear inventory.

CommercialProposalBFaq.description: Practical answers for teams evaluating a long-term technical partner.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_growth_answer: That is the point of the partnership model. We design for change: clear module boundaries, documented <api>APIs</api>, and a backlog of next steps. When you are ready, we extend the system without rewriting what already works.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_growth_question: What if our needs grow after launch?
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_integrations_answer: Yes. Most business apps must talk to accounting tools, CRMs, payment providers, or internal databases. We design <api>API</api> integrations and data flows carefully so your new system fits the landscape you already run.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_integrations_question: Can you integrate with our existing tools?
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_ownership_answer: You <highlight>own the code and intellectual property</highlight> for work you commission. There is no platform lock-in: you can host it yourself, bring in another team, or keep us as your ongoing partner.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_ownership_question: Who owns the code and IP?
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_security_answer: Security is part of the build, not an afterthought: access control, least-privilege design, secure defaults, and careful handling of credentials and personal data. We document what we put in place so your team can audit and operate it.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_start_small_answer: Yes. Many engagements begin with a single <microservice>microservice</microservice> or focused internal tool that proves value quickly. We keep interfaces clean so that tool can later connect into a wider platform.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_start_small_question: Can we start with a small tool instead of a full platform?
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_support_answer: After handoff you can self-manage, call us per request, or set up a lightweight retainer for monitoring, updates, and small improvements. Dedicated support means a known contact — not a ticket black hole.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_support_question: What does ongoing support look like?
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_timeline_answer: A focused MVP often lands in a matter of weeks once discovery is clear. Larger platforms are delivered in phases so you see working software early. We agree milestones up front and keep them visible.
CommercialProposalBFaq.faq_timeline_question: How long does a typical engagement take?

FreelanceProposalBFaq.faq_notice_answer: Standard notice is <highlight>two to four weeks</highlight> depending on engagement length. If you need a hard end date for budget cycles, we plan knowledge transfer early.

TechStackSection.next: We use NextJS for our website projects. NextJS uses advanced loading techniques to provide a the fastest experience. It uses React under the hood so we have access to all the great libraries out there. When possible we prefer to use NextJS over standalone React, Vue or Laravel + JavaScript Framework solutions due to the massive performance boost NextJS provides. codehouse.sandercokart.com was build with this!
TechStackSection.react: React is our go-to framework for building websites and digital tools. The reason behind this is that React has the largest community and is the most popular framework. This means we can save a lot of time by using existing solutions and libraries to speed up development.
TechStackSection.title: Tech Stack
TechStackSection.vue: We use VueJS as an alternative to React. It is often combined with NuxtJS which is much like NextJS, but for Vue. Statistically speaking, Vue is faster than React due to how it handles reactivity. It is much younger than React though and has a smaller community. This means that there are less existing solutions and libraries available.

FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.title: Questions before we start
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.description: Straight answers about how freelance end-to-end delivery works — scope, ownership, and what to expect.
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_scope_question: How do you define <highlight>scope</highlight> before building?
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_scope_answer: We start with a discovery phase: goals, users, constraints, and must-haves. You get a written scope with milestones and an honest timeline — no vague estimates that balloon later.
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_ownership_answer: You do. Once the project is paid for, the full codebase, deployment config, and documentation are yours. No platform lock-in.
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_timeline_question: How long does a typical project take?
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_timeline_answer: Focused web apps often ship in <highlight>4–8 weeks</highlight>; larger platforms take longer and release in iterative milestones. We agree on phases upfront so timelines stay realistic.
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_communication_question: How do we stay <highlight>aligned</highlight> during the build?
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_communication_answer: Regular demos, async updates, and a shared milestone tracker. You see working software — not just ticket counts — at every stage.
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_stack_question: Can you work with our existing <highlight>stack</highlight>?
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_stack_answer: Yes. I primarily work with React, Next.js, Laravel, and TypeScript, but can integrate with your existing infrastructure and APIs when it makes sense.
FreelanceProposalCFaqSection.faq_handoff_answer: Full source access, deployment walkthrough, and documentation. I include a post-launch support window and can stay on for maintenance if you want ongoing help.

FreelanceProposalDFaq.title: Hiring into your team
FreelanceProposalDFaq.description: Practical answers for leads and engineering managers considering a freelance senior embed.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_hours_answer: Engagements are usually <highlight>part-time or full-time</highlight> (roughly 16–40 hours per week). We agree on core overlap hours upfront so your team can plan standups and reviews.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_timezone_answer: I'm based in the Netherlands (CET/CEST) with strong overlap across European teams. For other regions we define a daily overlap window — async updates keep momentum when clocks differ.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_tools_question: Can you use our <highlight>tools</highlight> and workflows?
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_tools_answer: Yes. Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Notion, Slack, Teams — I adapt to your stack. No forced toolchain changes unless you want process improvements.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_ownership_answer: You do. Everything produced under our agreement belongs to your organization. I do not retain IP over work delivered in your repos.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_sprint_question: How quickly can you fit a <highlight>sprint</highlight>?
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_sprint_answer: Most teams slot me in <highlight>within one sprint</highlight> of kickoff. Onboarding is designed to land a merged PR in the first week so you see velocity, not ramp-up slides.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_notice_answer: Standard notice is <highlight>two to four weeks</highlight> depending on engagement length. If you need a hard end date for budget cycles, we plan knowledge transfer early.
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_remote_question: How does <highlight>remote collaboration</highlight> work day to day?
FreelanceProposalDFaq.faq_remote_answer: Video standups when you want them, async written updates otherwise, and PRs as the source of truth. I document decisions in your wiki or tickets so the team stays aligned when we're not in the same room.
